_comment: The StationlyPrefs.selections blob as a v1 install holds it, written by
kotlinx omits properties at their default, so a v1 blob carries ONLY the
fields v1's UserSelection had. Every field v2 added is absent here, and
that is the point: this is the shape v2 must still be able to read on the
Three rows: a plain tube board, and a bus hub whose two directions resolve
to different poles (Smithwood Close, route 39 — hub 490012211N, inbound

expect._boardsNote: THREE, not two. A v1 blob has no parentStationId, so groupingId falls back to `station` and the bus hub's two poles are two boards. This is v1's own behaviour and is what the user sees today; the hub only becomes one board once a v2 client re-resolves it. AV2-4.3's fold-up must not mistake this for data loss.
